hero.eyebrow: The visual studio for AI agents
hero.lede: Nodestro connects AI models, tools and knowledge into agent workflows that you build visually, run under your control and follow step by step.
hero.diagram: Diagram: models, knowledge and tools come together in Nodestro and become connected agents, approvals and traceable runs.

how.title: From an idea to a run you can follow.
how.intro: A workflow is a chain of agents. Each brings its own model, tools and knowledge, and hands its result to the next.

design.title: Design
design.text: Arrange and connect agents in the editor – or describe the workflow in your own words and let the architect draft it.

run.title: Run
run.text: One click starts the workflow. Wherever you decide, it waits for your approval before it continues.

trace.title: Trace
trace.text: Every run shows the inputs and outputs, tool calls, tokens and costs of each individual agent.

capabilities.title: Everything agent workflows need. In one place.

workflows.title: Visual editor
workflows.text: Agents as nodes, connections as data flow – with branches and sub-workflows.

agents.title: Agents
agents.text: Model, instructions, tools, memory and output format: set up once, reusable everywhere.

tools.title: Tools
tools.text: Your own Python functions, written and tested by AI if you like, plus services via MCP.

knowledge.title: Knowledge and memory
knowledge.text: Assign documents as background knowledge and see what an agent remembers.

executions.title: Runs
executions.text: Live progress of every run, side-by-side comparison of two runs, and tokens and costs per agent.

automation.title: Automation
automation.text: Batches, test suites and schedules run workflows repeatedly and verifiably.

local.title: Local and private
local.text: Nodestro runs on your computer. Data leaves it only for requests to the AI providers you set up.

providers.title: Provider-independent
providers.text: Anthropic, OpenAI, Google Gemini, Ollama, vLLM or an OpenAI-compatible endpoint – chosen per agent.

integration.title: Open to integrate
integration.text: Start any workflow from your own applications through the API and the SDK.

closing.title: Your first workflow is just a few clicks away.
closing.text: Start with an example from the gallery or with an empty workflow.
